train_MetaLearnModelSelect: train a meta-learner model selection classifier using RandomForest on time series metadata
pred_MetaLearnModelSelect: predict the best forecasting model for a new time series using the trained meta-learner
pred_fuzzy_MetaLearnModelSelect: predict the best forecasting model using fuzzy bootstrap method with significance level
